actor-id.description: Source identifier of the user, principal or other identity associated with the activity.

actor-upn.description: User principal name supplied by the source.

application-id.description: Application registration ID reported by the source.

application-name.description: Application display name reported by the source.

category.description: Directory audit category supplied by Microsoft Entra.

conditional-access-status.description: Conditional Access status reported for the Entra sign-in.

correlation-id.description: Correlation identifier explicitly present in the audit record.

event-time.description: The source event timestamp normalized to UTC.

event-time-raw.description: Original event timestamp, including any precision beyond microseconds.

home-tenant-id.description: Home tenant reported for the Entra sign-in.

ingestion-time.description: Explicit Microsoft Log Analytics TimeGenerated for a sign-in, normalized to UTC.

ingestion-time-raw.description: Original sign-in ingestion timestamp, including any precision beyond microseconds.

interactive.description: Whether Microsoft reports that the sign-in was interactive.

log-type.description: Microsoft log source represented by this observation.

operation.description: Reported audit operation or Entra sign-in.

operation-type.description: Directory audit operation type supplied by Microsoft Entra.

outcome.description: Normalized result when the source provides enough context to interpret the reported activity outcome.

record-id.description: Native audit record identifier in the named log and reporting tenant.

record-type.description: Native workload record type from the Unified Audit Log.

resource-id.description: Reported principal resource or workload ObjectId.

resource-name.description: Resource display name reported by the source.

resource-tenant-id.description: Resource tenant reported for the Entra sign-in.

result-code.description: Numeric status error code from an Entra sign-in, recorded as exact text.

result-status.description: Native result text. The source and workload determine its meaning.

review-status.description: Analyst review status of the imported observation.

service-principal-id.description: Service principal object ID, distinct from its application registration ID.

session-id.description: Session identifier explicitly present in the audit record.

source-address.description: Original client or source address, which may include a port or proxy address.

source-ip.description: Validated IP address from the reported source address.

target-resource.description: One JSON object with selected ID, type, name and user principal name for a directory audit target.

tenant-id.description: Reporting or collecting Microsoft tenant identifier.

workload.description: Microsoft workload or directory service reporting the audit record.

description: One Microsoft Entra sign-in or directory audit record or Microsoft Purview Unified Audit Log record. Link the originating export and tenant context through object references.
name: microsoft-audit-event
